prompt: Write a short Scottish joke generator as a single self-contained HTML file with inline JavaScript and CSS. It should generate a new, affectionate Scottish-themed joke (no slurs, nothing mean-spirited) each time a "Tell me another" button is pressed, by combining parts rather than just picking from a fixed list of complete jokes. No external libraries, fonts, images or network requests. Reply with only the HTML, starting with <!DOCTYPE html>.
